meta.name: hunt-cors
meta.description: Hunt CORS Misconfiguration — origin-reflection with credentials, null-origin trust, subdomain-regex bypass (unanchored vs unescaped-dot vs prefix-only), pre-flight (OPTIONS) gating bypass, postMessage origin checks. High only when an attacker-controlled origin can perform a CREDENTIALED cross-origin read of sensitive data and you have proven it in a browser. Use when testing API endpoints, SPAs, or any app emitting Access-Control-* headers.

copy.tagline: 检测并利用CORS配置漏洞进行跨域攻击
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要测试Web应用是否存在危险的CORS配置错误。
copy.tagline_en: Detect and exploit CORS misconfigurations for cross-origin attacks.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to test web apps for dangerous CORS misconfigurations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你检测 CORS 配置漏洞，包括反射任意 Origin、信任 null Origin、子域名正则绕过、预检绕过和 postMessage 检查。它会指导你手动测试并生成浏览器 PoC 来证明漏洞。
howto.when: 当你测试 API 端点、SPA 或任何返回 Access-Control-* 头的应用时触发。需要你提供目标 URL 和会话 cookie。

say.text: 检查这个子域名正则是否存在绕过：https://api.example.com
say.note: Claude 会列出多种绕过 payload 并指导你测试。

say.text: 生成一个浏览器 PoC 来读取 /api/me 的响应。
say.note: Claude 会提供 HTML 代码，你托管后打开即可验证。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you detect CORS misconfigurations including origin reflection, null-origin trust, subdomain regex bypass, preflight bypass, and postMessage checks. It guides manual testing and browser PoC generation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when testing API endpoints, SPAs, or any app returning Access-Control-* headers. Requires target URL and session cookie.

say_en.text: Test this API endpoint for CORS reflection: https://example.com/api/me
say_en.note: Claude guides you to send requests with Origin header and check response.

say_en.text: Check subdomain regex bypass for: https://api.example.com
say_en.note: Claude lists bypass payloads and guides testing.

say_en.text: Generate a browser PoC to read /api/me response.
say_en.note: Claude provides HTML code; host and open to verify.
